title: Rates >= 48 (eg_timer_low_lock rotation)
description: Cases whose non-constant increment rows are all >= 48. The library follows the published table, Nuked latches the timer's low bits one tick late, so these are compared with the documented one-EG-tick counter shift -- exactly, not with a tolerance. See golden/DISCREPANCIES.md.
format: level/out/state are flat [sample,value,...] change lists; a value holds until the next pair. out is Nuked eg_out already shifted back by its 1-sample pipeline lag, and is omitted when it equals level. gate is [sample,keyed_on,...].
